description: Names for the places the game marks on its maps (MapParam Facility), keyed by the record's GameDataHashName, or BossDoor:<dungeon> for boss doors, which have none. Written by hand from the game's own names for them and the objects at each place (zeldamods' Owl Object Map). category is shop, fairy, minigame, person or boss.
